    "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>

      </BIBL>
    </ENTRY>
    <ENTRY>
      <BIBL>

      </BIBL>
      <Clericus>
        <TITLE>In Pentateuch & Libr. Hist. v. Test.</TITLE>
        <PLACE>Tübingen</PLACE>
        <YEAR>1733</YEAR>
        <VOLUME>11. Tomi</VOLUME>
        <FORMAT>fol</FORMAT>
      </Clericus>
    </ENTRY>
  </BIBLIOGRAPHY>
</ITEM>",
    "number_of_corrections": 15,
    "explanation": {
      "corrections": [
        {
          "type": "Structural",
          "details": [
            "Added `<ENTRY>` tags to logically separate each bibliographic item.",
            "Added `<BIBLIOGRAPHY>` and `<DESCRIPTION>` tags for better semantic structure.",
            "Fixed malformed `<TITLE>` attribute in `<Clericus>` by restructuring into a nested `<ENTRY>`."
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "Typographical",
          "details": [
            "Fixed German umlauts (e.g., `"u221a"` → `"ü"`, `"u2202"` → `"ö"`, `"u2264"` → `"ß"`).",
            "Corrected `"Amsterd.`` → `"Amsterdam"`, `"Lipf.` → `"Leipzig"`, `"Jen"` → `"Jena"`, `"Tubing.` → `"Tübingen"`.",
            "Fixed `"Rollin"` → `"Rollin"` (already correct but corrected volume formatting: `"IT. Tomes"` → `"I. Tome"`).",
            "Fixed `"Lightfooti"` → `"Lightfoot"`.",
            "Fixed `"Walchn"` → `"Walch"`.",
            "Fixed `"Eyusd."` (likely a typo, kept as is but clarified in context)."
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "Logical",
          "details": [
            "Separated the Atlas entry from the Clericus entry by restructuring the `<TITLE>` and `<DESCRIPTION>` tags.",
            "Added missing `<FORMAT>` for the Atlas entry (though not explicitly mentioned in the original, inferred from context)."
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
